notes:
FEATURES
• Watched folders collect new screenshots in an inbox. MarkSeal sweeps them at launch and watches them while it runs.
• Manual watches scan new images when you open the folder. Automatic watches scan, confirm, and export them into the watch's redacted folder with a coordinate log. Automatic work pauses while its folder is open or a manual batch runs, and queued files resume after a restart.
• The inbox shows new, waiting, needs-review, and auto-redacted counts. Process existing handles the files already in the folder, and Stop pauses automatic work until you resume it with Process existing or by switching the watch back to Auto.
• A Watched folders tab in Settings and a Watches toolbar entry.

The Windows installer remains unsigned; Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning. Watched folders are images-only and cover the top level of each folder. Originals are never modified, and exports never overwrite.
